aiSummary: In October 2026, macOS Catalina led macos versions (desktop) in Oceania at 70.71% (market share of tracked page views / usage). macOS 15.7 ranked second at 4.46%, followed by macOS 15.6 at 2.56%.

faqs.question: Which item leads macos versions (desktop) in Oceania?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina leads at 70.71% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/macos-version-market-share/desktop/oceania.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for macos versions (desktop) in Oceania?
faqs.answer: macOS Catalina (70.71%), macOS 15.7 (4.46%), macOS 15.6 (2.56%) in October 2026.
